As Sales Account Manager Export, you will be responsible for expanding and strengthening our business across international markets outside Western Europe. 
 

You will focus primarily on developing relationships with large customers and distributors, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term partnerships.
 

You combine a strategic outlook with a hands-on approach to drive sales performance and unlock new opportunities.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 

•    Develop and manage relationships with key accounts and international distributors

•    Drive sales growth across export markets outside Western Europe

•    Identify and develop new business opportunities in assigned regions

•    Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts 

•    Set-up, manage, motivate, and support a network of agents

•    Monitor sales performance and ensure targets are achieved

•    Analyze market trends and customer needs to define growth strategies

•    Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and supply chain

•    Represent the company at international trade fairs and customer meetings

•    You will translate internal commercial strategies into action and continuously improve the end-to-end sales process via our CRM platform (Dynamics 365). 

•    Proven experience in an international sales or export role

•    Strong experience managing key accounts and/or distributors

•    Commercially driven with excellent negotiation skills

•    Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented

•    Strong communication and relationship-building skills

•    Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)

•    Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis

At its Ghent facility, Legend Biotech focuses on the manufacturing of advanced CAR-T cell therapies for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
	
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment	
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
	
• Cell isolation	
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction	
• Cell culture	
• Aseptic processing	
• Filling and finishing operations	
• Cryopreservation
Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
	
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards
Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
	
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability
Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

Who are you?

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.

You have:
	
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field	
• Initial experience with cell culture	
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset	
• Good command of English, both written and spoken	
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system	
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association. 
 
• bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository. 
 
• bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects. 
 
• bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback. 
 
• bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department. 
 
• bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases. 
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

The Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH will manage pricing and tender processes within the life sciences industry, ensuring accuracy and compliance. This role is focused on delivering high-quality customer service support.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in medical supplies and accessories.

They are looking for a temporary (but with probability of becoming permanent) Tender & Pricing Coordinator who is fluent in German and English.

Description

As a Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH you will have two main pillars:

 

1) Pricing

 

• You analyse pricing strategies and habits in your markets and develop the company's pricing structure
• You make sure prices get approved and implemented
• You communicate new price quotations to your customers
• You are responsible for implementing your pricing in SAP
• You update price catalogues
 

2) Tender & Sales Support

 

• You manage tender processes from A to Z (preparation, analyses, contracts, pitches, ...)
• You communicate important contract changes
• You monitor the tender renewals
• You analyze clients complaints regarding contracting and pricing
 

 

 

 

A successful Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH should have:

• Experience in tender, pricing and customer service or administrative roles
• Knowledge of pricing and tender processes
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Attention to detail and accuracy in handling documents
• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SAP
• Fluency in English and German
• Ideally your are immediately available

As a 1st Line Customer Support Agent, you are the first point of contact for customers, handling inquiries via phone and/or ticketing system. You will provide technical support and customer service for users in transportation products and services.

Your primary goal is to deliver accurate and timely support to customers, aiming to resolve issues efficiently or escalate them when necessary. You will also support product installations and validations.

This is a time-sensitive role, requiring prompt and clear communication to ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Handling incoming support calls (triage), ensuring all calls are addressed

• 
Managing support tickets in the assigned language queue(s) on a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) basis

• 
Performing initial analysis of reported issues

• 
Conducting validation calls and following up with installers

• 
Processing Return Authorization (RA) tickets

• 
Following escalation procedures and adhering to support policies

• 
Communicating effectively with customers across various channels

Desired Skills and Experience : 

• 
Fluent in Dutch, French, English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in both spoken and written form

• 
Comfortable working in an IT and software-driven environment

• 
Strong organizational skills, with a proactive and reliable attitude

• 
Eagerness to learn new products and procedures

• 
Previous experience in a customer support center is a plus

Industrial investment projects in a process environment

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within an industrial process setting from start to finish. You retain full responsibility throughout the project lifecycle for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The assignment covers both greenfield initiatives and substantial modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept phase through commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Set and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline schedule in MS Project.
• Steer all project stages, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Serve as the main accountable point of contact for stakeholders and management during the full project trajectory.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains.
• Control scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations with impact on cost or planning.
• Provide clear reporting on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to building and owning project schedules, not just tracking them.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical capabilities with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority to complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Are you ready to step into a Finance Controller role where your experience truly counts from day one?
Apply now and bring your expertise to an organization shaping the future of mobility.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Finance Controller who can step in quickly and make an immediate impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.

Your role

As a Finance Controller, you play a key role in ensuring financial transparency, control, and insight across the organization. This is a plug-and-play role: you are operational from day one and work autonomously with limited onboarding.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• Monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reporting	
• Budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis	
• Analysis of costs, margins, and performance	
• Supporting management with financial insights and decision-making	
• Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and external requirements	
• Preparing audits and improving internal controls	
• Acting as a sparring partner for operational and technical stakeholders

Your profile
	
• Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics	
• 5+ years experience as Finance Controller or similar role	
• Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow	
• Excellent Excel skills and experience with ERP systems	
• Able to work independently and accurately in a complex environment	
• Hands-on, proactive, and pragmatic mindset	
• Comfortable in an international and technical context	
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
